run_create_video_world: run the script to generate an MP4 video of optimal transport on the sphere
run_plot_geodesics: run the plot function to render geodesic transport paths between supply and demand points
run_sinkhorn_solver: run the Sinkhorn solver to compute optimal transport plans for supply-demand pairs on a sphere
run_world_pair_sampler: run the WorldPairSampler to generate random supply and demand distribution pairs on a sphere
run_euclidean_to_spherical: run the euclidean_to_spherical utility to convert 3D Euclidean coordinates to spherical coordinates
